page_title: BAR 5-0 BET | Barcelona v Betis 16/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

90+1' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) comes close to scoring. He peels away from his marker and gets on the end of a cross from Marcos Alonso, but he hits a shot just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
90' We will have 2 min. of added time.

89' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) latches on to a precise lofted cross inside the box, controls the ball and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. His dangerous effort is blocked by Francisco Vieites, who makes a glorious save!
87' Raphinha (Barcelona) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
86' Inigo Martinez (Barcelona) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
84' Guido Rodriguez (Betis) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jose Sanchez had an easy-decision to make.

81' 5 - 0 Goal! Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom left corner. Francisco Vieites had no chance of reaching it. The score is 5:0.
81' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
76' Here is a change. Andreas Christensen is going off and Xavi gives the last tactical orders to Inigo Martinez (Barcelona).
76' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Alejandro Balde walks off the pitch to be replaced by Marcos Alonso (Barcelona).

76' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Barcelona will have a goal kick.
75' The attendance is 45055.

73' Raphinha (Barcelona) blows a huge opportunity after receiving a cross from the free kick. He shoots from just outside of the box, but the ball goes narrowly wide of the right post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
72' Jose Sanchez shows a yellow card to Marc Bartra (Betis) for his blatant foul.
71' The resulting corner from Raphinha (Barcelona) is cleared.
66' It will be a substitution. Guido Rodriguez (Betis) is ready to enter the pitch as Marc Roca walks off.
66' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to substitute Ayoze Perez and he is replaced by Juan Cruz (Betis).
66' Isco comes off the pitch to be replaced by Rodri (Betis).
66' 4 - 0 Raphinha (Barcelona) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom right corner.
64' That's the end of the game for Joao Felix, who is replaced by Lamine Yamal (Barcelona).
64' Xavi prepares a substitution. Ferran Torres is replaced by Raphinha (Barcelona).
64' Today's match ends for Oriol Romeu who will be replaced by Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona).
62' 3 - 0 Ferran Torres (Barcelona) takes the free kick and sends it towards the bottom right corner of the goal, giving the goalkeeper no chance.

61' Marc Roca (Betis) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for an infringement. Barcelona win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
58' A goal, which was scored by Joao Felix (Barcelona), was disallowed due to offside.
57' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) sends a cross into the box, but Francisco Vieites comes off his line to gather the ball.

52' Barcelona are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.

49' Oriol Romeu (Barcelona) superbly controls a difficult pass on the edge of the box and effortlessly let's fly with a magnificent low strike towards the middle of the goal, which the keeper somehow pushes away.
48' Joao Felix (Barcelona) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Manuel Pellegrini probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Luiz Henrique. He is replaced by Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis).
46' Manuel Pellegrini makes a switch. Francisco Vieites is coming on in place of Rui Silva (Betis) at the start of the second period.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The end of the first half.

45+4' Chadi Riad (Betis) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the middle of the goal. However, he couldn't beat Marc-Andre ter Stegen, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
45+4' Isco (Betis) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
45+4' Marc Roca (Betis) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared. Betis force a corner. They send men into the box.
45+3' The ball is laid off to Joao Felix (Barcelona) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the bottom right corner and forces Rui Silva to make a decent save.
45+2' Isco (Betis) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
45+2' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Betis. Isco (Betis) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

45+1' CHANCE! Willian Jose (Betis) goes very close! He gathers a cross inside the box and fires a shot towards Marc-Andre ter Stegen, who produces an excellent reflex save. The ball is out of play. Betis will have a chance to score from a corner.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Willian Jose (Betis) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
43' Joao Felix (Barcelona) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
41' Rui Silva comes off his line to intercept the corner from Joao Felix (Barcelona).
40' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Marc Roca (Betis). Jose Sanchez saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
38' Neat passing move from Barcelona in order to create new attacking opportunities.
36' Rui Silva (Betis) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
32' 2 - 0 Andreas Christensen plays a neat ball into the path of Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona), who makes room for a shot and sends in a low drive which bounces in off the left post! 2:0.

28' Willian Jose (Betis) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Barcelona will have a goal kick.
28' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Isco (Betis) takes it short.
27' Juan Miranda (Betis) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The linesman points to the corner flag, Betis are going to take it.
27' Isco (Betis) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
25' 1 - 0 Spectacular goal! Joao Felix (Barcelona) brilliantly darts into the box to latch on to a cross and buries the ball into the bottom left corner, leaving the goalkeeper stunned!
20' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Rui Silva intercepts the ball.
19' Joao Felix (Barcelona) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
14' Joao Felix (Barcelona) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
13' Jose Sanchez blows for a foul after Marc Roca (Betis) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
11' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) sprays a pass out to Robert Lewandowski, but he can't beat his man inside the box.
10' Joao Felix (Barcelona) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
10' Good defending. Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) tries to find Joao Felix inside the box, but the pass is cut out. Barcelona will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
8' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
7' A precise low pass is received by Joao Cancelo (Barcelona), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
4' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) passes the ball onto Robert Lewandowski, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
1' Betis enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Barcelona will take the kick-off.
